author: Antonio Clim
prior_information: S02 source, specifications and existing tests were inspected in this resumed session. No S03 measurement was executed in this session before this lock. A prior hash-only commitment exists but its protocol bytes and any subsequent local outcomes were not recovered from the provided archives, current filesystem or targeted Library searches. This protocol is a transparent replacement for resumed execution, not a claim of uninterrupted preregistration.

sampling.design: deterministic finite conformance corpus, not a population sample
sampling.independence: Generated variants and observation-level comparisons are dependent; no binomial confidence interval, p-value or external error-rate estimate will be inferred.

estimands: violating case count / eligible case count per hypothesis
discrepant observation count / compared observation count
typed refusal, unexpected exception and timeout counts
comparison.callable_alignment: source-order ordinal within each artifact; do not align by renamed spelling or content hash
comparison.decision: Any unexplained violation fails its hypothesis for the tested implementation. Repairs are reported separately and never erase baseline failures. Expected sensitivity must be declared here or logged as a deviation rather than relabelled retrospectively.

hypotheses.invariant: all observation values, states, record IDs, evidence IDs, adapter fingerprints and measurement_digest; path metadata excluded
normalised hash; all observation values and states except source.byte_count; normalised evidence and record IDs
hypotheses.exact_change: raw byte count increases by the number of original LF characters

hypotheses.invariant: normalised hash; all observation values and states except source.byte_count; normalised evidence and record IDs
hypotheses.exact_change: raw byte count increases by 3 and encoding becomes utf-8-sig

hypotheses.invariant: all Python observation values and states; callable correspondence by ordinal
hypotheses.precondition: generated names only; no attribute or import-name substitution; AST shape is independently compared after inverse renaming

hypotheses.invariant: Python AST-derived counts, coverage proportions, callable decision counts, complexity and nesting
hypotheses.exact_change: comment token and comment physical-line counts increase by one

hypotheses.invariant: Python AST structure excluding positions and all Python AST-derived observations except callable physical spans
hypotheses.precondition: stdlib tokenize/untokenize formatter applied to the generated Python 3.10-compatible subset; not a claim about every formatter

hypotheses.invariant: no partial result and no zero substitution
generic source observations remain typed and source-bound
hypotheses.exact_change: python.parse_status is syntax_error; the 15 singleton AST-dependent values are unavailable/null/ME-006; no fabricated callable instances
allowed_changes: lexical comment availability depending on tokenizer

oracles.generic: independent character scanner and Decimal-based moments
oracles.python: analytic expectations for generated grammar plus an independent iterative traversal sharing CPython ast; the shared front-end limits independence
oracles.markdown: independent character-state implementation of the declared finite subset, including homogeneous fence closers
oracles.routes: measure_bytes versus measure_file and the existing S01 adapter only; no browser or legacy-v2 equivalence
oracles.metamorphic_generators: generator preconditions are checked independently of measured results; generator defects are logged, not counted as product failures

adversarial.resource_policy: No fixture code is executed. High-depth and exhaustion probes run in a child process, with 15-second timeout and 512 MiB address-space cap on POSIX when supported. Windows timeout-only coverage is explicitly qualified. Fault injection is labelled separately from real resource exhaustion.
adversarial.acceptance: Malformed and over-budget inputs must yield typed MeasurementError, documented parse missingness or documented API contract rejection, never a successful fabricated measurement. Every unexpected exception, timeout and validator false acceptance is retained.

platform_policy: One exact-candidate CI cycle. Compare path-free canonical outputs of the common core byte corpus across all four cells. Runtime grammar frontiers and OS-only symlink/resource checks are reported separately. Local Python 3.13.5 is additional development evidence, not a substitute for pinned cells.
preservation: Keep the immutable baseline, every generated input, generator hash, manifest, all baseline and repaired results, deviations and negative results. No post-hoc hypothesis edit. Append follow-up scope rather than overwriting this file.
exit: All named tests pass or each failure receives an explicit defensible disposition; exact remote source identity and SHA-specific CI are required for closure. A01-F003 and the 19 historical findings receive individual evidence-bounded adjudication. No main, app-version, licence, tag, release or Zenodo change.
